source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Without horizontal scrolling, the final visible resizable thread column absorbs layout width and its splitter is disabled. With scrolling, the final visible resizable column can resize. Columns explicitly marked non-resizable remain excluded. The accepted #updateView code distinguishes the last visible column class from the last visible resizable column splitter; hidden columns are excluded. Preserve those two conditions when changing column setup.
title: Allow resizing the last visible resizable column only when scrolling permits it
